name: Onee Gyaru
summary: Onee Gyaru, directly translating to “Older Sister Gal” is both a descriptive term and substyle of Gyaru.
description:
Onee Gyaru, directly translating to “Older Sister Gal” is both a descriptive term and substyle of Gyaru. It is typically used to refer to Gyaru who have graduated high school, usually around 20-35 in age, and also refers to a sub style of Gyaru that is more matured, and "tone downed" in style.

It is a mature, sophisticated Japanese fashion substyle that mixes the edgy, glamorous elements of traditional Gyaru with elegant, high-end adult styling. Onee Gyaru shares the chaotic and neon layers of younger Gyaru styles for an expensive, polished aesthetic.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Confidence
